reviewDescription: This product is incredibly tedious! 1. A major gripe I have with this set is they're battery life doesn't work individually out of the case. Which means if one is low battery, both of them will turn off instead of the one. To add insult to injury, The headphones will only be on for 30 seconds once one of them is low. You have to turn off whatever your listening to for both to not immediately die. It gives you two warnings, and then both of them turn of. Which leads you to put both in and out of the case again, hold the sensor to turn one off, or if it works, reconnect through Bluetooth. - I'm not sure if this is a poor feature, or it's just my headphones, but the left one's battery life only lasts for an hour, while the right can last from 6 to 8 hours. I used to think that the left just wasn't in the charging port correctly, but no girl, it is! So I'll charge both overnight, and when I want invest some time in a project or video game, the left dies. 2. I thought that I would like the replacement sensor instead of a button on the side of the headphones, but I don't. It can be pretty finicky and tedious when one individual sensor functions for everything. But just like any sensor, if you tap it with anything that isn't your finger, it goes completely crazy. So my daily experience is either a race against the clock when the left one is dieing to quickly put it back into the port so both don't turn off! Orrr, I simply have the right one in, so I can't get the full sound. Yes, the sound is descent, but it's nothing to write home about. Along with the base mode. I don't hear a lot of difference. And even if I could experience the full sound, I have to subject myself to a thirty second sprint across the room so both do not die, with a sensor that only works sometimes. By the time i just settle for the right, the only thing I'm thinking about is my life choices! 😂
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on July 2, 2026
